async def test_evaluate_handles_empty_fields():

    evaluator.config = {}
    case = SimpleNamespace(expected_output={})
    execution = SimpleNamespace(output={})
    result = await evaluator.evaluate(case, execution)
    assert result.score == 0.0
    assert result.passed is False

from app.evaluators.deterministic.retrieval_metrics import RecallAtKEvaluator, EvaluationCase, SystemExecution, EvaluationResult


def test_recall_at_k_uses_default_when_k_missing():
    # Minimal stubs for required schemas
    case = EvaluationCase(expected_output={"relevant_document_ids": ["doc1"]})
    execution = SystemExecution(output={"retrieved_documents": [{"id": "doc1"}]})
    evaluator = RecallAtKEvaluator(config={})
    # Should not raise TypeError even though "k" is missing
    result: EvaluationResult = await evaluator.evaluate(case, execution)  # type: ignore[await-outside-async]
    assert isinstance(result, EvaluationResult)
